title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.23229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. translated_title: 环境大语言模型：通过温度匹配实现数据高效的监督微调
translated_abstract: 为自回归语言模型收集大规模、多样化且高质量的后训练数据集是极具挑战性的。因此，监督微调（SFT）通常应用于远小于预训练规模的数据集，这会导致过拟合以及对数据分布尾部信息的灾难性遗忘。为了防止这种崩溃，我们提出了Ambient SFT，这是一个利用不完美预测来扩充微调数据集的原则性框架。在我们的方法中，预训练模型的“冻结”版本充当一个带噪声的教师，微调后的模型只需在粗粒度上与其匹配。特别是，我们要求后训练模型产生的高温条件分布版本应与预训练模型的高温条件分布版本相匹配。温度超参数控制着对预训练模型的信任程度，其极限为T→∞。
tldr: 提出Ambient SFT框架，通过将微调模型的高温条件分布与冻结的预训练“噪声教师”模型进行温度匹配，利用不完美预测扩充微调数据集，从而防止过拟合和数据分布尾部的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes Ambient SFT, a principled framework that matches high-temperature conditional distributions of the fine-tuned model with a frozen pre-trained noisy teacher, leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set and prevent overfitting and catastrophic forgetting of the data distribution tails.
